content: Krishiv is a builder focused on high-impact products at the intersection of AI, software, and hardware, with a long-term goal of founding a tech startup.
He is driven by curiosity and speed of learning—prefers shipping polished, useful tools over theory, and iterating based on real user feedback.
Internationally minded (grew up in Hong Kong, now at Georgia Tech), he values cross-cultural collaboration and building communities around ambitious ideas.
Computer Science student at Georgia Tech, pursuing threads in Artificial Intelligence and People and is pursuing a minor in Business.
Plans to participate in CREATE-X to accelerate a startup idea from prototype to launch.
Proficient in modern web development with TypeScript, React/Next.js, Tailwind, and API design.
Mobile development with React Native (Expo), strong attention to UI polish, motion, and dark-mode quality.
AI integration: OpenAI API, prompt engineering, embeddings, and light RAG patterns.
Vector search: familiar with various databases (e.g., pgvector); able to build context-aware chat using retrieved knowledge.
Graph reasoning: experience with knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j) for modeling relationships and orchestration logic.
Databases and backend: Supabase/Postgres, authentication, access control, and basic real-time features.
Embedded systems: Arduino/C++, UART serial communication, Bluetooth LE modules, servo control, and power management.
Robotics: path planning, obstacle avoidance, and asynchronous programming for concurrent sensor/actuator control.
Product and UX: systems thinking, clean typography, grid layout, micro-interactions, and recruiter-friendly storytelling.
SlideIn is an AI-powered cold-outreach platform that won 1st place at Georgia Tech’s Shipathon and reached 500k+ impressions after launch.
Built in under 24 hours: generates personalized outreach, automates sending, tracks replies, and visualizes analytics—framed as “Tinder for outreach.”
LinkUp is a social event discovery platform for Southeast Asia (Hong Kong, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur) with a Gen-Z focused mobile UX.
Implements user auth, event creation/RSVPs, private/invite-only events, and a friends system (requests, approvals, social feed) on Supabase.
Bluetooth Light Switch: Arduino + Adafruit Bluefruit LE UART + servo to toggle a physical light switch from a phone—built to automate a bunk-bed dorm setup.
Demonstrates embedded programming, stable power distribution, UART parsing, and a custom 3D-printed mount for secure housing.
Autonomous Delivery Robot: multifunctional robot for maze navigation, target delivery, and room sweeping using path-planning and obstacle avoidance.
Uses asynchronous control in C++ to read sensors and drive motors concurrently for responsive real-time navigation.
Flow AI: student productivity concept that extracts structured data from syllabi and generates gamified, bite-sized study plans via the OpenAI API.
Heston Volatility Model: implemented stochastic volatility pricing for options with attention to arbitrage constraints and realistic market dynamics.
Shark Sanctuary NFT Collection (Polygon): designed and coded 888 unique NFTs to raise awareness about shark finning with Hong Kong Shark Foundation.
Gained media recognition (RTHK 3 radio and Around Discovery Bay magazine) and educated audiences on conservation using web3.
Agent Zeta: explores giving agents “intuition” using dynamic knowledge graphs and orchestration for decision-making beyond simple task execution.
Investigates risk-aware world models and RAO-style interfaces to connect domains (e.g., cybersecurity to supply chain) via causal relationships.
BEST AND MOST RECENT: Software Developer Intern at GFO-X (Summer 2025): built Jira/Confluence agents using embeddings and cosine similarity to classify and retrieve internal knowledge.

Intern at Fundfluent (Summers 2022 & 2023): Built an AI-powered SEO blogging workflow and contributed to financing tools that support startups and SMEs. Selected by the CEO after a pitch competition and delivered projects that directly supported early-stage founders.

Junior Researcher at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (2021–2022): Conducted applied research on proton-exchange membrane fuel cells. Built and tested a model car powered by a passive fuel cell stack under the mentorship of three professors in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.

Research Analyst at Georgia Tech Venture Capital Club (2024–present): Contributes to market analysis and investment theses, focusing on AI startups. Helped prepare newsletter content highlighting trends in applied AI and early-stage company building.

Community Growth Team at Startup Exchange, Georgia Tech (2025–present): Builds partnerships with AI, FinTech, Product, and VC organizations to co-host events, connect builders, and expand Atlanta’s student startup ecosystem.

Head Student at West Island School (2021–2022): Represented ~18,000 students from over 80 nationalities. Focused on inclusive leadership, cross-cultural collaboration, and giving students a stronger voice in school governance.

Volunteer Leader at Kids4Kids (2019–2022): Oversaw a team of ~25 to tutor underprivileged youth. Produced 30+ STEM YouTube lessons for global audiences and organized hands-on building kits in partnership with nonprofits to promote accessible STEM education.

Equities Analyst at Georgia Tech Trading Club (2024–present): Led a student team in the Wharton Global High School Investment Competition, focusing on equity research and portfolio strategy while mentoring peers in valuation and trading fundamentals.
IYPT/HKYPT: bronze at Hong Kong Young Physicists’ Tournament, represented Hong Kong internationally, placing 15th globally.
Shipathon 2025: SlideIn won 1st place; project messaging and demo helped it go viral with 500k+ social impressions.
AI/ML applications, agents, and knowledge-graph-based reasoning for real products.
Startups and venture capital; enjoys founder-market fit thinking and distribution strategies.
FinTech and markets; applying quantitative models and AI to real financial workflows.
Developer tools and product design; cares about ergonomics, speed, and aesthetics of the builder experience.
Robotics and IoT; enjoys bridging software with the physical world through sensors and actuation.
Emotional wellness and personal growth; experiments with systems for presence, charisma, and relationship depth.
Plays guitar; sees music as a way to recharge and cultivate creativity.
Hiking and outdoor exploration; values time in nature for clarity and balance.
Travel; enjoys discovering new cultures and perspectives, informed by an international upbringing and study abroad.
Mentoring and tutoring; likes making complex concepts accessible through hands-on examples.
Building side projects for fun—rapid prototyping to test ideas and learn new stacks.
Motivated by solving practical problems—e.g., automating a dorm light switch for a bunk-bed setup—and scaling that mindset into products.
Wants to found a startup that blends AI with strong UX to deliver everyday utility, not just demos.
Values teams that move fast with high craftsmanship; learns best by building, shipping, and iterating with users.
Understands how to build a personal RAG: chunked JSON knowledge base → embeddings → Chroma retrieval → Gemini prompt.
Capable of maintaining a structured autobiography (projects, roles, skills, interests, motivations) for chatbot grounding.
Combines product sensibility with engineering depth; cares about reliability, clarity, and tasteful design.
Seeks mentors and communities that push him to pursue bigger, more ambitious builds with real users.
